findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed small amounts of food splash to be present at the sauce warmer and prep cooler lid. Discussed with PIC, both areas were cleaned during inspection. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food splash accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The dough mixer is observed with dried on dough residual. PIC instructed to clean and moved the equipment to dish for cleaning.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The spray bottle of sanitizer at the facility is observed with a minimal color change on test strips indicating a solution that is not at effective levels. The bottle was remade to correct.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

Observed a spatula used for removing stuck dough from a dough press stored between the table and the wall. Discussed with the PIC and stated that this was an unsafe location to store in use food dispensing utensils. The spatula was moved during the inspection.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-160  Observed a scrapping tool soiled from previous use. Tool was resting on the counter of the preparation cooler. Scrapper was removed for cleaning during the inspection. Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 Observed a spray bottle of 409 cleaner to be stored on the small counter adjacent to the meat slicer. Moved from food preparation area during the inspection.  All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the caulk coming apart from the wall at the mop sink. Recaulk the mopsink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a cooler that was not holding temperature below 41F.  Ham, ranch, mayo, noodles and salami were all discarded during the inspection.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the scoops in the bulk powders to be laying in the food. Make sure scoops are extended out of the food to prevent cross contamination.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a broken gasket on the salad cooler next to the stove/oven. Repair the broken gasket.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed bosco stix to be uncovered in the reach in freezer. Make sure to properly protect food at all times.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed paper goods stored on the floor in the dry storage. Make sure to store all items at least 6" off the floor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Single service articles not re-used
findings.comment:
Observed Italian beef containers being re-used to hold other products (cheese). Facility can purchase food grade liners or use food grade containers.
750-600 Re-use of single-service articles is prohibited. Do not re-use single service items.
